author: Martiusik
quote:
Remake of the greatest game ever made, graphics, story, everything is simply beautiful.
This is the game that we’ve been waiting for over 30 years!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Martiusik
quote: A masterpiece in every sense of the word. The story and the music are phenomenal, and the freedom in this game is what made it so popular. It's a piece of gaming history that will never be forgotten. A true masterpiece.

author: Martiusik
quote: This game was an amazing and beautiful experience. The controls are great, though they can be uncomfortable at first. As for the atmosphere, I felt like I was in a storybook, and the graphics still look great even though this game came out in 2007!

author: Martiusik
quote: This game invented the action - adventure genre,If this game didn’t exist gaming would be much different than it right now, but of course it isn’t perfect. The controls are uncomfortable the graphics are not great but still, this game came out in 1998! And for that time… this game was a banger,Trying to downplay this game’s impact on gaming is ridiculous
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)
